subtasks.title: Write tests verifying prompt_planner.go extraction
subtasks.description:
Add tests in prompt_planner_test.go that verify:
1. plannerInstructions() is callable and returns non-empty sections (smoke test from new file location)
2. prompt.go line count is under 800 lines (the acceptance criterion for this refactor)
3. prepInstructions does not exist as a callable symbol (compile-time verified by absence)

The test for line count should read prompt.go via os.ReadFile, count newlines, and assert <= 800. This encodes the acceptance criterion as an automated check.

Existing tests in prompt_test.go and prompt_depth_test.go already cover plannerInstructions content thoroughly — do NOT duplicate those. Focus on structural acceptance criteria only.

File: internal/prompt/prompt_planner_test.go
Pattern: Follow existing test style in prompt_test.go (uses testing package, string matching with strings.Contains).
The test for line count uses: bytes.Count(data, []byte("\n")) and asserts <= 800.

subtasks.title: Extract plannerInstructions to prompt_planner.go and delete prepInstructions
subtasks.description:
Two changes to internal/prompt/prompt.go:

**1. Move plannerInstructions to new file prompt_planner.go**
- CUT lines 260-478 from prompt.go (the comment + plannerInstructions function)
- CREATE internal/prompt/prompt_planner.go with package declaration and the moved function
- The function signature is: func plannerInstructions() []string
- It has NO imports — it only uses string literals and append()
- The call site at prompt.go:179 (`sections = append(sections, plannerInstructions()...)`) stays unchanged — same package, no import needed
- Follow the pattern from prompt_review_fixer.go: package declaration, then the function

**2. Delete dead prepInstructions function**
- DELETE lines 794-938 from prompt.go (comment + prepInstructions function)
- This function has ZERO callers (confirmed by grep)
- It uses filepath and fmt imports, but both are still used elsewhere in prompt.go, so no import cleanup needed

**After both changes:**
- prompt.go shrinks from 938 lines to ~720 lines (under 800-line ceiling)
- prompt_planner.go is ~219 lines
- All existing tests pass unchanged (same package, same function signatures)

**Critical: do NOT modify any existing test files. Do NOT change any function signatures. This is a pure code-move + dead-code-delete.**

subtasks.title: Integration verification
subtasks.description:
Verify the extraction is complete and correct:
1. Run `go vet ./internal/prompt/...` — must pass
2. Run `go test ./internal/prompt/...` — all existing tests must pass
3. Verify prompt.go is under 800 lines: `wc -l internal/prompt/prompt.go`
4. Verify prompt_planner.go exists and contains plannerInstructions
5. Verify prepInstructions is gone: `grep -r prepInstructions internal/prompt/` should return nothing
6. Run `gofmt -l internal/prompt/` — no output

This subtask does not need integration wiring — the extraction is intra-package with no new exports or cross-package changes. The verification is the test.
